bootstrap_loss_rule: Same consumed and spent original stays burned. Read-end closure remains pending on every path until a known close report. Stopped prefixes allow at most one unattempted closure phase, solely capability hygiene; no reread/relaunch/worker advance or failure clearing. Failed/unknown close is not retried.
byte_and_time_rule: Private count/timing assumptions: 1..65536 raw bytes, symbolic read FD3, elapsed nonnegative and strictly below10000ms, canonical one-envelope-plus-EOF/authentication reports. No actual native stream/parser/signature/timer proof.
dependency_rule: Caller SHA-pins unchanged340/341 and registers fixed private aliases. Module has no file/IPC/process/target/argv dispatch.
guard_rule: Arm traps and establish external original live-fence/child-set reports before supervisor guard acquisition/fresh-original in memory; complete all-writer/alias/identity/freshcapture assumptions required; no guard reacquire.
identity_rule: Exact stored consumed/spent/dependency/source/bootstrap/traps/fence views; independent launch/context/scope/authentication/containment reports; no worker broker/service/RPC channel even for live fence.
linear_model_rule: Immutable linear prefix retains attempts and first failure. Repeated evaluation/copying is possible; not native/global once execution or authentication.
preflight_rule: Only after known authenticated read and known closure; retain readonly early view separately, never promote it to baseline.
